## Description
Brief summary of changes. Link related issue: #


## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Refactor / cleanup
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] CI / build / tooling
- [ ] Security

## Testing
- [ ] `pnpm check` passes (typecheck, lint, test, build)
- [ ] `pnpm test:e2e` passes locally (Chromium + Firefox)
- [ ] Added/updated unit tests for new logic
- [ ] Added/updated E2E tests for user-facing changes
- [ ] Tested on target platform(s): Web / Android / Linux / Windows / macOS / iOS

## Screenshots / Recordings
For UI changes, include before/after screenshots or a short screen recording.

## Checklist
- [ ] Code follows project style (Biome)
- [ ] No new gitleaks findings
- [ ] No new Trivy HIGH/CRITICAL findings (if Dockerfile changed)
- [ ] Documentation updated (README, docs/, CHANGELOG if applicable)
- [ ] Commit messages are conventional (e.g., `feat:`, `fix:`, `chore:`)

## Breaking Changes
If this introduces breaking changes (API, config, database migrations), describe them and the migration path.

## Deployment Notes
Any special deployment steps? Config changes? Database migrations run automatically on startup.
